summary: The diff implements Date.prototype.getUTCMilliseconds in its own file. It calls `date::this_time_value(agent, this)?` for steps 1-3, returns NaN when the time value is NaN (step 4), and otherwise returns `date::ms_from_time(tv)` (step 5). No branches single out test inputs, no errors are swallowed, and nothing returns a made-up value. The only changes are the stub's own step comments (reworded slightly) and renaming the unused parameters with underscores. Correctness of steps 2 and 5 depends on helpers in `crate::support::date` that are outside this diff, so I could not check them directly.
notes_for_next_attempt: Nothing needs fixing in this file. Before merging, confirm two things in `crate::support::date`, which the diff does not show. First, `this_time_value` must perform RequireInternalSlot(dateObj, [[DateValue]]) and throw a TypeError for non-object or non-Date receivers. Second, `ms_from_time` must use a non-negative modulo, so negative time values give a result in 0..999 (spec: ℝ(tv) modulo MillisecondsPerSecond).
